  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # PostgreSQL — first-run cluster init (dev-only trust auth).
  # Bootstrap over the Unix socket only (listen_addresses="" => no TCP), so
  # cluster creation never collides with anything already on $PGPORT and can
  # never hang on a foreign server's password prompt. The service (below)
  # binds TCP for the app.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w \
      -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=''" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    createdb -h /tmp -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" </dev/null
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
  fi
"""

[services.postgres]
command = """
  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -k /tmp \
    -c listen_addresses="$PGHOST"
"""
